slots.title: Replies in *minutes*, not hours
slots.body: Built to answer new enquiries quickly, ask the right questions and book the job in.
points: Books, or hands over to you

slots.title: A fast, *useful* first reply
points: Customer: Hi, do you do bathroom repaints?
Reply: Yes, we do. Which suburb is the job in?
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: Gets the *details* you need
slots.body: Only what you would ask: the job, the place, the timing.
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: Offers real *times*
slots.body: Instead of "when are you free?", it offers times that are open.
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: Booked, or *handed* to you
slots.body: When the customer picks a time, it's booked. When it needs your judgement, the conversation comes to you.
points: Details saved to the customer record
slots.label: Concept demonstration

slots.title: In sandbox *testing*
slots.body: Today the AI Setter runs practice conversations in our test lab. It isn't replying to real customers yet.
